INDEPENDENT REVIEW — ACCEPT 14720f6503e5bf577419aa60cdb062add5e05039 for bd-01M158ACR8F9X3BA3HG7CVRKZ6. Candidate-slice type verdict: CLEAN, 0 blocker/major/minor findings across the exact seven paths.

PLAN RECONCILIATION:
- Opaque BasisId over family plus ordered FeatureTargetKey.parts: upheld. Mixed families return DomainError; order changes identity; empty bases retain family identity.
- derivationId and no-basis outputSpaceId stability: upheld. The old no-basis code path is unchanged and pinned.
- basis-bearing output formula: upheld exactly. Independent SHA-256 recomputation produced basis 08a021d6... and output 0ea2b30c..., matching the goldens.
- production propagation: Aggregate.overTargets, Aggregate.overBasis, and Windowed.overBasis all use the same BasisId for output-space identity and TrackProvenance. FeatureTrack.validated rejects raw+basis and mismatched basis/output.
- wire compatibility: BasisId decodes only through validated Checksum; TrackProvenance absent basisId decodes None; FeatureTrack decode revalidates mismatches.
- caches: no production cache keys directly on derivationId; DerivationGraph is keyed by the now basis-bearing FeatureSpaceId.

ERGONOMICS: the nonempty convenience overload infers family then delegates to the family-explicit checked path. Empty basis requires the caller to name the consequential family choice. No broad conversion, cast, stringly error, sentinel, suppressor, unlawful instance, or duplicated algebra appeared.

MUTATION/CAPACITY: the reported mutation replacing basis-aware output construction with d.outputSpaceId is load-bearing against direct reordered-basis, provenance, graph-addressability, and validation assertions. I inspected that capacity but did not repeat the source mutation because this assignment was explicitly read-only.

VERIFIED LOCALLY AT THE EXACT SHA: featuresJVM 43/43 and codecJVM 97/97. Required sibling seam independently completed at storyatlas4s c9f9e365dd6668af95f19b7ac4d4e33c40343a53 against provider 14720f6: compileAll PASS and testAll PASS, 95 JVM/Scala.js tests, zero failures.

SHOULD-HAVE-CHANGED, OUTSIDE THE RESERVED SLICE: view/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/view/compiler.scala:16-49 is now a stale migration placeholder. FeatureSelection.Derived still carries Option[Checksum], and every Some(basisId) returns BasisIdentityUnavailable even though features.BasisId now exists. This is fail-closed, so it is not a blocker to the seven-path candidate, but it is a real typed integration follow-up and must be separately routed before any end-to-end basis-aware view claim. No other stale BasisId/derivationId/cache sites found.
